flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts (type declaration only), pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{useSearch.ts,useSearchParams.tsx} (search by warrant_no), pages/NoticeSearch/form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx; ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (path list only). No entity/controller/service/cron for warrant of arrest in any of the six repos.
note: The story asks OCMS to receive and process warrant status updates from State Courts. There is no receiver, parser, warrant entity or database update. There is no entity, repository, controller, service, cron or SFTP/API client for Warrant of Arrest in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi or ocmseserviceapi (case-insensitive grep: warrant, woa, state court, send_to_sc, roms_error, warrantofarrest, woc_number; synonyms court mention/trial/outcome also checked). The only traces are the TypeScript type Iwarrantofarrest in ocmsadminui and a GET call to endpoint 'warrantofarrest' used to search notices; the path /v1/warrantofarrest is in the authorization list but no controller or entity serves it. The CAS inbound endpoints in CasIntegrationController (casGetPaymentStatus, casUpdateCourtNotices, plus-get-court-case-info, plus-payment-activation) are not credited: they are calls from CAS/PLUS to OCMS about court notices, not warrant updates to/from State Courts. Story status is blank in the data.
recommendation: Do not claim. The CAS inbound endpoints are not a receiver of warrant status from State Courts; ask URA/the team in which repo this feature was built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: OCMS receives the warrant status update from State Courts
steps.detail: There is no endpoint, SFTP poller or cron receiving State Courts data in thirdpartyapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep state court, warrant, ROMS: 0 hits). The only inbound endpoints are in CasIntegrationController (casGetPaymentStatus line 42, casUpdateCourtNotices line 101, plus-get-court-case-info line 167, plus-payment-activation line 220): these are calls from CAS/PLUS about court notices and payments, not warrant status from State Courts, so they are not credited. The real caller: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS validates and parses the status update
steps.detail: There is no parser/validator for warrant status records. The relevant fields (warrant_status_flg, warrant_exec_date, woc_number, case_appl_status, case_status_recd_date) only exist in the UI type (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:19-38).

steps.step: OCMS updates the warrant record (status, execution date)
steps.detail: There is no warrant entity/repository in ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/.../crud/ocmsizdb (entity list checked: no OcmsWarrantOfArrest) nor in ocmsadminprivateapi. The GET 'warrantofarrest' call in useSearch.ts:68-78 has no backend controller.

steps.step: Records that fail are stored as errors for reporting
steps.detail: There is no storage of warrant processing errors (roms_error_code/roms_error_flag are only UI type fields, Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:28-30).
